experimental_method: Isopiestic comparison at 383-523 K of {(1-y)NaCl + yLiCl}(aq) solutions with NaCl(aq) as the isopiestic standard in titanium cups on a copper block in a sealed pressure vessel, molalities obtained by in situ electromagnetic-balance weighing.
uncertainties_stated: molalities accurate to better than 0.2 per cent (reproducibility, calibration with standard masses, duplicates); last digit of most molalities not significant
quality_remarks: Paper title: Isopiestic studies of aqueous solutions at elevated temperatures IX. {(1-y)NaCl+yLiCl}(aq) (Holmes and Mesmer). The text layer had six misread digits (see changes). A few dilute rows show a slightly non-monotonic dependence on y as printed.

table_1.note: printed rows by temperature 10,8,9,10,10,9; the right block has one row fewer at 383.19 K (9 vs 10), at 413.22 K 8 vs 8, 523.17 K (8 vs 9)

extraction_notes: Text layer parsed by script, then every cell compared with 300 dpi crops of the page images. Stacked layout described in mapping_1.json. Temperature scale not stated; pressure not stated. Mixture compositions are y (mole fraction LiCl in the salt) in the column headers.
needs_pass2_reason: six cells needed correction after the image check (text layer unreliable), so SPEC convention 14 requires a second pass
changes_after_pass2: table 1 rows 50, 82, 84 (file lines): 4.0715->4.0775, 5.3517->5.3577, 4.7193->4.7793; the OCR text layer and pass 1 read 7 as 1, pass 2 and a 600 dpi crop agree on the corrected values
pass2_diff: Table 1: 110 rows; pass 2 disagreed on 3 cells (4.0715/4.0775, 5.3517/5.3577, 4.7193/4.7793); arbitrated with a 600 dpi crop: pass 2 was right in all three, pass 1 corrected.
